title: Podcast metadata input
description: Search Apple Podcasts, look up by collection ID, and/or parse RSS feed URLs. Returns show + optional episode metadata only — No transcription, no audio download, no email/contacts. Failed/empty feeds are free.

searchKeywords.title: Search keywords
searchKeywords.description: Terms to search on the public iTunes Search API (media=podcast). Each keyword returns up to searchLimitPerKeyword shows.

podcastIds.title: Apple podcast / collection IDs
podcastIds.description: Apple Podcasts collection IDs (numeric) or full podcasts.apple.com URLs containing /idNNNN. Looked up via iTunes Lookup API.

feedUrls.title: Feed URLs
feedUrls.description: Direct podcast RSS/Atom feed URLs. Parsed with feedparser for show + episode metadata. Audio enclosures are listed as enclosureUrl only — never downloaded.

country.title: iTunes store country
country.description: ISO 2-letter country code for iTunes Search/Lookup (e.g. us, gb, tw, jp).

includeEpisodes.title: Include episode list
includeEpisodes.description: When true, fetch each show's feedUrl and emit episode metadata rows (title, published, duration, enclosureUrl, showNotesHash). No audio download / No transcription.

maxShows.title: Max shows
maxShows.description: Cap on podcast shows processed (search + lookup + feed URLs combined). 0 = unlimited (subject to spending limit).

maxEpisodesPerShow.title: Max episodes per show
maxEpisodesPerShow.description: Cap episodes read from each RSS feed (feed order, usually newest first). 0 = unlimited. Ignored when includeEpisodes is false.

searchLimitPerKeyword.title: Search results per keyword
searchLimitPerKeyword.description: iTunes Search API limit parameter (1–200) per keyword.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Parallel feed fetches (1–20). Keep modest on 256 MB.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: HTTP timeout for iTunes and feed requests.

maxRetries.title: Max retries
maxRetries.description: Extra attempts after the first failure when fetching a feed.

userAgent.title: User-Agent
userAgent.description: Optional custom User-Agent for HTTP requests.

chargeFailedShows.title: Charge failed shows
chargeFailedShows.description: Default false: failed lookups and empty/broken feeds are free. Enable only if you want error rows billed as podcast-show.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify Proxy. Usually unnecessary for iTunes + public feeds.

maxFeedBytes.title: Max feed bytes
maxFeedBytes.description: Abort a single feed download if the body exceeds this many bytes (default 5_000_000). Prevents hang on huge feeds. Oversized/failed feeds are free.
